decision.reason: [ev-e7cf2f463686] says only that ServiceAccount annotations are now run through Helm `tpl`. It does not name the values key paths, and the chart may have more than one ServiceAccount; the values validator could not find `serviceAccount.annotations` in the defaults. The proposed condition is also probably too broad. Running `tpl` would only change the rendered output for annotation keys or values that contain template syntax (e.g. `{{`), so flagging every environment that sets the key would include environments that aren't exposed. To write an exact exposure condition I would need the PR #7501 chart diff, which shows which values keys get `tpl` applied.
